sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the ship-owned frameProfileType relationship and the correct KiloN unit. Repair applicability by removing mandatory sh:minCount constraints for longitudinalFrameOrientation and structuralLocation; the rule must apply only when both supplied values are true/sideStructureLocation, without requiring every structural member to provide them. Correct ownership and paths: combinedShearAndBendingDemand is load-case-owned, while midspanPlasticCollapseLoad and plasticStrength are structural-member-owned, so do not seek all three quantities on ?loadCase.
